en-US.description: Desktop manager for WSL containers (wslc) on Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
WSL Container (wslc) Desktop Manager on Windows
Based on Microsoft's official WSL Container API and the wslc CLI, providing graphical management for images, containers, Compose orchestration, volumes, and logs.
Features
- Dashboard: Environment status, resource quotas, active sessions
- Containers: List, resource stats, start/stop/delete, open port URLs, logs
- Orchestration: Compose project deployment, editing, rebuilding, stopping, deletion
- Images: View, delete, pull history
- Volumes: Mount volume management
- Logs & Auditing: Container log viewing, operation audit trails
- Settings: Sessions, image registry mirrors, appearance

zh-CN.description: Windows 平台上的 WSL 容器（wslc）桌面管理器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Windows 上的 WSL 容器（wslc）桌面管理器
基于微软官方 WSL Container API 与 wslc CLI，提供镜像、容器、Compose 编排、卷、日志的图形化管理。
特性
- 仪表盘：环境状态、资源配额、活动会话
- 容器：列表、资源统计、启停/删除、打开端口网址、日志
- 编排：Compose 项目部署、编辑、重建、停止、删除
- 镜像：查看、删除、拉取记录
- 卷：挂载卷管理
- 日志与审计：容器日志查看、操作留痕
- 设置：会话、镜像加速、外观
zh-CN.name: WSLCC
